evidence.note: Title 'About 40% of what flats on blocks C and D spend on electricity falls in daylight hours' matches costs.md (about 40% of spend between 08:00 and 18:00, audit p6).
'£612 median yearly electricity spend per flat, 2025' matches costs.md (median £612, 2025, 48 flats); note 1 carries the caveat that 41 of 48 households shared bills.

Note adds 'That is the share a rooftop array can supply directly', cited to audit p6; no research file says the array can supply that whole daytime share (costs.md p6 states only the 40% split; pilot.md gives no supply coverage figure).

rationale: The title and stat are precise to costs.md, and the 41-of-48 bills caveat sits in the note. But note 2 attributes to the audit an unsupported claim that a rooftop array can directly supply the full 40% daytime share, adding detail and certainty beyond the source. That meets the fail descriptor.
